cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

mechanism: A claims supervisory care over the customer while granting progressively less practical information about the dress.
confusable: Unlike brusque obstruction, every narrowing of access comes wrapped in personal reassurance and an offer to stay.
comparison: A customer seeking depot access differs from a caregiver containing school consequences.
seedUse: Use dress, vague depot and withheld number from the seed; express S01 as directing the customer's care and contact.
